truth-or-dare-generator.formula:
Fisher-Yates shuffle: for i from n-1 down to 1, swap card i with a random card j where j <= i.
Every ordering is equally likely (n! possibilities for n cards). Each draw takes the top card; the deck is reshuffled only when empty — so no prompt repeats until all 12 of that kind have appeared.
howTo: Type the current player's name (optional) so the prompt card shows who is up.
Tap Truth for a question, Dare for a challenge, or Surprise Me to let fate decide.
Read the prompt out loud and complete it honestly — that is the whole game.
Keep going around the group. The counters track how many truths and dares have been done.
Press New Session to reset the decks and counters for a fresh round.

truth-or-dare-generator.workedExample:
The truth deck holds 12 prompts, shuffled into a random order.
1. First draw: "What is the silliest thing you believed as a child?" — 11 cards remain.
2. Second draw: "Which movie can you quote almost line by line?" — 10 remain, and it cannot repeat the first.
3. After 12 draws the deck is empty and reshuffles into a new random order.
The 13th draw can repeat an old prompt, but never before all 12 have appeared once.
